notes: Hotfix: Custom Code JavaScript now supports $() and $$() helpers, matching browser DevTools behaviour. Scripts using $$() were failing silently before this update.
Hotfix: fixes button styles appearing broken after the v1.4.0 update due to browsers caching the old CSS. Update immediately if buttons on your site look broken.
Hotfix: fixes a 500 error on all frontend pages after the v1.4.0 update. Update immediately if you're seeing an Internal Server Error on your site.

New: Site Migration — export your entire site to a single .pagezy file and import it on any Pagezy server in one click (pages, posts, media, settings, menus, and more). New: HTML/ZIP Import into FlexiBuilder — upload any HTML template or ZIP archive directly into the page builder, images auto-uploaded to Media Library. New: Pages Quick Edit — edit title, slug, template, and status inline without opening the full editor. New: Button brand controls — set primary and secondary button colours in Brand & Design. Fixed: Deals settings crash, pages flash messages.
Bug fix: custom font upload (.otf/.ttf files now accepted). New: upload multiple font weights/styles (Regular, Bold, Italic) under one family name.
MySQL database backup (pure PHP, no exec needed), Search & Replace tool, FlexiBuilder canvas colour sync, and HTML export fix.
Swiper.js slider builder, scheduled publishing, analytics, saved blocks, blog comments, image focal point, page duplicate.
FlexiBuilder stability fix, UX improvements, author display name override.
